changelog: v1.5.2: Allow official Indian government apps (including Kerala Police com.keralapolice, in.gov.*, and com.nic.*) only when verified from Play Store.

windows.changelog: v2.8.0: Approvals now have a lifetime - every prompt offers This run only / Until restart (default) / Always, so a click no longer becomes a permanent rule. A signed program that updates itself is asked again instead of being silently blocked forever (fixes Microsoft Edge not connecting after an update). Every blocked connection shows a plain-language reason in a new Why column, and the dashboard verifies its rules by reading them back out of Windows Firewall instead of claiming success blindly.
